decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the core thermoforming range, so keeping the option open costs little even without recent website evidence.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple material with steady lab demand and negligible carrying cost, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The UV-curing lacquer only ever had a weak web presence and its uptake remains uncertain, but as a listed consumable it is still cheap to keep within the growing digital printing workflow.
Custom earmolds run on the firm's existing custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so the option remains inexpensive to hold despite limited visibility.
Custom hearing protection shares the earmold production base and keeps growth potential in occupational markets, so it is worth keeping while demand matures.
